hero.title: A 6,000-Unit Madinah Community, Explored in 3D
hero.body: Families buying off-plan at Al-Mukiman in central Madinah explore their future homes on a Manzili 3D twin and showroom touch tables, guided by trained sales staff.

sidebar: Al-Mukiman · NHC destination masterplan · 3,545,000+ m² · 6,000+ residential units
WebGL masterplan twin · Multi-touch sales gallery displays · Sales team certification

challenge.title: Clear Answers for Multi-Generational Family Buyers
challenge.body: Family buyers in central Madinah decide together, and they need to see height limits, setbacks and privacy clearly before they commit to an off-plan home.

cards.title: Strict Height and Setback Rules
cards.body: Municipal height limits and privacy setbacks near the Prophet's Mosque need exact validation, which 2D floor plans can't provide.

cards.title: Slow Tools, Back to Brochures
cards.body: Across 3.5M+ m², slow-loading portals pushed consultants back to printed brochures and WhatsApp PDFs at peak family visiting hours.

cards.title: Many Decision-Makers
cards.body: Extended families who can't read blueprints take longer to agree, delaying reservations.

solution.title: A Turnkey Sales Setup for Al-Mukiman
solution.body: The Al-Mukiman sales center runs on a browser-based WebGL twin and showroom touch tables, with structured sales playbooks for the frontline team.

blocks.label: 01 · Digital Twin
blocks.title: Browser-Based Community Twin
blocks.body: A no-download WebGL masterplan of all 3.5M+ m² of Al-Mukiman, showing building massing, roads, mosques, schools and plot-level daylight in 4K at 60 FPS.

features.title: Boundary Context
features.body: Accurate distances to the Prophet's Mosque area

blocks.label: 03 · Showroom Hardware
blocks.title: Sales Gallery Hardware
blocks.body: 65-inch 4K multi-touch tables installed in the permanent sales center, backed by local computing that removes network lag in busy consultations.

features.title: Dual-Display Mode
features.body: Touch table mirrored to LED walls

blocks.label: 04 · Sales Enablement
blocks.title: Sales Playbooks for Family Buyers
blocks.body: On-site coaching replaced passive feature tours with a structured presentation built for Saudi family buyers.
